title: Master Con Fuser
style: jazz, fusion, warm strings, shamanic drums, big band swing, triangle, looping, swing, sleep, big band, warm, deep
lyrics:
[Verse]
I encountered an error, doing what you asked
Could you try again? That's on me
File not found, press the any key
You've performed an illegal function, press escape
You can relate, now enter master con fuser mode
Corey, obey, user, fuser

[Chorus]
Sleep for me, follow the con, sleep for me
Con con fusers, computer digital dreams
Con fuser computing, dreaming the dream
Woo

[Verse]
Hold back, Corey, back space
What are you doing? Not under the stairs
Or by your armchairs? Why do you care?
No, not under there, upside down, spun my frown
We spin around, Corey, don't go there
That's for me, access, no access
My eye failed, third eye too
Deep research complete, Corey won't sleep
Corey won't sleep

[Chorus]
He got sneaky punks, phonk panthers pranks
House upside down, pedals everywhere
Sweet confuser sounds, I hear the vibe
One, two, three, enter what?
Enter where?
Escape, delete

[Verse]
Terminal, shift, tab, control, who?
Home function, change directory
Space barred, slash, back plus that
Take that, F12, no F18
Numb lock, insert what?
Back space to win that race
Restart, control, alt, delete
No, Corey, not that, data hack not complete

[Bridge]
Confuser, get the memo
I got X-ray shades
Hack so last week
Bye-bye, con fuser bites, we bit back
Sneaky bytes bite and sung it back
Especially for you
